info.title: Raisely Universal API
info.description: Manage Raisely campaigns, profiles, donations, users, and subscriptions

post.description: Creates a new donation in Raisely.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

data.address1.description:
Line 1 of an address
Example: `31 Sunset Boulevard`

data.anonymous.description:
Does the donor wish to be anonymous
Examples: `true`, `false`

data.campaignUuid.description:
Unique identifier for the record
Example: `aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa`

data.card.description:
ID of the payment method used (from the payment gateway)
Example: `card_aabbccddeeffaabbccddeeff`

data.customer.description: The customer ID (assigned by the payment gateway)

data.date.description:
The date and time (in ISO8601 format) the donation was received by the organisation (only for OFFLINE donations)
Example: `2020-12-03T06:52:46.330Z`

data.email.description:
Email address of the donor
Example: `harveymilk@example.com`

data.firstName.description:
The first name of the person
Example: `Leila`

data.forRegistration.description:
Not null values indicate this transaction has been set aside to pay for an upcoming registration
Examples: `true`, `null`

data.fullName.description:
The full name of the person
Example: `Leila Norma Eulalia Josefa Magistrado de Lima`

data.gatewayVersion.description: Gateway Version of donation method, if any

data.items[]..amount.description: The amount spent on the item in the currency of the donation

data.items[]..amountRefunded.description: The total amount refunded in cents for this line item, in the donation currency.

data.items[]..attendance.description: Whether the donation item (ticket) has been checked in

data.items[]..includeInTotals.description: If false, the amount is not included in receipts as part of the total donation

data.items[]..quantity.description: If multiple of the item, the number of items claimed

data.lastName.description:
The last name of the person
Example: `de Lima`

data.message.description:
Message from the donor
Example: `Glad to help out with the fundraising!`

data.methodType.description:
The type of payment method used, to distinguish between card, direct debit and digital wallet payments.
Examples: `APPLE_PAY`, `CARD`, `GOOGLE_PAY`, `BROWSER_PAY`

data.phoneNumber.description:
Phone number of the donor
Example: `+1 123-456-7890`

data.postcode.description:
Postal code of the donor
Examples: `AAA BBBB`, `0000`, `AAA BBB`

data.preferredName.description:
The name that the person prefers to be called
Example: `Norma`

data.profileUuid.description:
Unique identifier for the record
Example: `aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa`

data.swiftAidStatus.description:
Status of donation on SwiftAid
Examples: `OK`, `FAILED`, `PENDING`, `DELETING`, `DELETED`

data.token.description:
The payment token from the gateway
Example: `tok_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`

post.description: Creates a new subscription in Raisely.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

data.anonymous.description:
True if the person's name should be hidden from donation feeds
Examples: `true`, `false`

data.card.description:
The gateway card ID to charge when collecting the subscription
Example: `card_aabbccddeeffaabbccddeeff`

data.count.description:
The frequency of the subscription, used in conjunction with the `interval` property. For instance, a monthly subscription would have a `count` of `1` and an `interval` of `MONTH`. A fortnightly subscription would have a `count` of `2` and an `interval` of `WEEK`.
Examples: `1`, `4`

data.currency.description:
ISO alpha-3 letter currency code
Examples: `AUD`, `USD`

data.customer.description:
The gateway customer ID (only used when importing new subscriptions)
Example: `cus_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx`

data.email.description:
The user's email address. Raisely uses this as a unique identifier and will associate the subscription with an existing record if the email matches.
Example: `harveymilk@example.com`

data.firstName.description:
The first name of the person
Example: `Leila`

data.fullName.description:
The full name of the person
Example: `Leila Norma Eulalia Josefa Magistrado de Lima`

data.interval.description:
The interval of the subscriptions. See `count`.
Examples: `WEEK`, `MONTH`, `YEAR`

data.items[]..amount.description: `public` The amount spent on the item in the currency of the donation

data.items[]..amountRefunded.description: `public` The total amount refunded in cents for this line item, in the donation currency.

data.items[]..attendance.description: `public` Whether the donation item (ticket) has been checked in

data.items[]..campaignAmount.description: `public` The amount spent on the item in the currency of the campaign

data.items[]..includeInTotals.description: `public` If false, the amount is not included in receipts as part of the total donation

data.items[]..originalAmount.description: `public` The total amount of this line item in cents prior to any refunds, in the donation currency. Amount is tax inclusive.

data.items[]..parentBundleItem.description: `public` The item ID / reference of this ticket's parent bundle

data.items[]..productUuid.description: `public` The uuid for the associated product or ticket.

data.items[]..quantity.description: `public` If multiple of the item, the number of items claimed

data.items[]..status.description: `public` The status of the donation item

data.items[]..type.description: `public` The item type. For most manual API calls, you should use the value `OTHER`.

data.lastName.description:
The last name of the person
Example: `de Lima`

data.message.description:
A public message left by the donor
Example: `Glad to help out with the fundraising!`

data.method.description:
The payment gateway used for the subscription. Use STRIPE_INTENT for new subscriptions.
Examples: `STRIPE_INTENT`, `CREDIT_CARD`, `CUSTOM`, `PAYPAL`

data.methodType.description:
The type of payment method used, to distinguish between card, direct debit and digital wallet payments.
Examples: `CARD`, `APPLE_PAY`, `GOOGLE_PAY`, `BROWSER_PAY`, `DD_BACS`, `DD_BECS`

data.nextPayment.description:
An ISO8601 timestamp of the next payment due date. Raisely will charge the donation after this date.
Example: `2020-12-03T06:52:46.330Z`

data.preferredDay.description:
Stores the preferred day for the subscription to be billed on. If interval is WEEK, it's day of the week. If interval is MONTH, it's the day of the month. If interval is YEAR, it's day of the year.
Example: `12345`

data.preferredName.description:
The name that the person prefers to be called
Example: `Norma`

data.source.description:
The source of this subscription. Subscriptions created through the API should have a source of `OFFLINE`.
Examples: `OFFLINE`, `ONLINE`

data.token.description:
Payment gateway token. Set to `null` when adding offline subscriptions with `card` and `customer`.
Examples: `seti_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx`, `EXISTING_CARD`

data.treatAsNewSubscription.description:
This field is only for importing new subscriptions. When false (default), the first successful charge of the card will result in a subscription.rebilled event. Set to true to change the first event to subscription.succeeded and send the Regular Donation Welcome message on the first payment after import.
Examples: `true`, `false`

put.description: Updates an existing campaign in Raisely.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

campaign.description: The `uuid`, `path` or domain of the campaign to associate with the request

data.allowExperiments.description:
Allows the campaign to participate in Raisely experiments
Examples: `true`, `false`

data.defaultCampaignFund.description: Fund that is assigned as the default fund for the campaign

data.mode.description:
Mode for payment processing. Make sure to set this to LIVE before launching your campaign so you can take real donations.
Examples: `LIVE`, `TEST`

data.name.description:
Name of the campaign
Example: `<< campaign name >>`

data.path.description:
The path of this record (for alternative lookup)
Example: `run-for-a-cure`

put.description: Updates an existing subscription in Raisely.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

data.anonymous.description:
True if the person's name should be hidden from donation feeds
Examples: `true`, `false`

data.card.description:
The gateway card ID to charge when collecting the subscription
Example: `card_aabbccddeeffaabbccddeeff`

data.count.description:
The frequency of the subscription, used in conjunction with the `interval` property. For instance, a monthly subscription would have a `count` of `1` and an `interval` of `MONTH`. A fortnightly subscription would have a `count` of `2` and an `interval` of `WEEK`.
Examples: `1`, `4`

data.currency.description:
ISO alpha-3 letter currency code
Examples: `AUD`, `USD`

data.customer.description:
The gateway customer ID (only used when importing new subscriptions)
Example: `cus_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx`

data.email.description:
The user's email address. Raisely uses this as a unique identifier and will associate the subscription with an existing record if the email matches.
Example: `harveymilk@example.com`

data.firstName.description:
The first name of the person
Example: `Leila`

data.fullName.description:
The full name of the person
Example: `Leila Norma Eulalia Josefa Magistrado de Lima`

data.interval.description:
The interval of the subscriptions. See `count`.
Examples: `WEEK`, `MONTH`, `YEAR`

data.items[]..amount.description: `public` The amount spent on the item in the currency of the donation

data.items[]..amountRefunded.description: `public` The total amount refunded in cents for this line item, in the donation currency.

data.items[]..attendance.description: `public` Whether the donation item (ticket) has been checked in

data.items[]..campaignAmount.description: `public` The amount spent on the item in the currency of the campaign

data.items[]..includeInTotals.description: `public` If false, the amount is not included in receipts as part of the total donation

data.items[]..originalAmount.description: `public` The total amount of this line item in cents prior to any refunds, in the donation currency. Amount is tax inclusive.

data.items[]..parentBundleItem.description: `public` The item ID / reference of this ticket's parent bundle

data.items[]..productUuid.description: `public` The uuid for the associated product or ticket.

data.items[]..quantity.description: `public` If multiple of the item, the number of items claimed

data.items[]..status.description: `public` The status of the donation item

data.items[]..type.description: `public` The item type. For most manual API calls, you should use the value `OTHER`.

data.lastName.description:
The last name of the person
Example: `de Lima`

data.message.description:
A public message left by the donor
Example: `Glad to help out with the fundraising!`

data.method.description:
The payment gateway used for the subscription. Use STRIPE_INTENT for new subscriptions.
Examples: `STRIPE_INTENT`, `CREDIT_CARD`, `CUSTOM`, `PAYPAL`

data.methodType.description:
The type of payment method used, to distinguish between card, direct debit and digital wallet payments.
Examples: `CARD`, `APPLE_PAY`, `GOOGLE_PAY`, `BROWSER_PAY`, `DD_BACS`, `DD_BECS`

data.nextPayment.description:
An ISO8601 timestamp of the next payment due date. Raisely will charge the donation after this date.
Example: `2020-12-03T06:52:46.330Z`

data.preferredDay.description:
Stores the preferred day for the subscription to be billed on. If interval is WEEK, it's day of the week. If interval is MONTH, it's the day of the month. If interval is YEAR, it's day of the year.
Example: `12345`

data.preferredName.description:
The name that the person prefers to be called
Example: `Norma`

data.source.description:
The source of this subscription. Subscriptions created through the API should have a source of `OFFLINE`.
Examples: `OFFLINE`, `ONLINE`

data.token.description:
Payment gateway token. Set to `null` when adding offline subscriptions with `card` and `customer`.
Examples: `seti_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx`, `EXISTING_CARD`

data.treatAsNewSubscription.description:
This field is only for importing new subscriptions. When false (default), the first successful charge of the card will result in a subscription.rebilled event. Set to true to change the first event to subscription.succeeded and send the Regular Donation Welcome message on the first payment after import.
Examples: `true`, `false`
